description: Grafana dashboard for Cilium Flows - Hubble Observer

panels.title: Flows between clusters, in the range shown
panels.description: Every flow from or to the namespaces mongodb and search (replication, mongot's sync, searches), counted once at its destination, by the cluster it came from and the cluster it went to. 'host or outside' is traffic from no pod, such as a node's probes. Nine pairs of clusters is a full mesh.

targets.expr: sum by (src, dst) (count_over_time({namespace="$hubbleobservernamespace",container="$container"} | $logparser | label_format src=`{{ or .flow_source_cluster_name "host or outside" }}`, dst=`{{ or .flow_destination_cluster_name "host or outside" }}` [$__range]))

panels.title: Flows to search (port 27028) between clusters, in the range shown
panels.description: Flows to port 27028 in the namespace search (mongod to Envoy, and Envoy to mongot), by the cluster they came from and the cluster that received them. Hubble flows are not requests: with Cilium's default monitor aggregation (medium, 5 s), an open connection's packets are reported at most every 5 s. A row from one cluster to another is a cluster's searches answered by another cluster, as after a failover.

targets.expr: sum by (src, dst) (count_over_time({namespace="$hubbleobservernamespace",container="$container"} | $logparser | flow_destination_namespace="search" | flow_l4_TCP_destination_port="27028" | label_format src=`{{ or .flow_source_cluster_name "host or outside" }}`, dst=`{{ or .flow_destination_cluster_name "host or outside" }}` [$__range]))

panels.title: Flows to search (port 27028) per minute, by receiving cluster
panels.description: Flows to port 27028 in the namespace search, per minute, by the cluster that received them. Hubble flows are not requests: with Cilium's default monitor aggregation (medium, 5 s), an open connection's packets are reported at most every 5 s. A cluster whose line drops to 0 while another rises has had its searches moved there.

targets.expr: sum by (dst) (count_over_time({namespace="$hubbleobservernamespace",container="$container"} | $logparser | flow_destination_namespace="search" | flow_l4_TCP_destination_port="27028" | label_format src=`{{ or .flow_source_cluster_name "host or outside" }}`, dst=`{{ or .flow_destination_cluster_name "host or outside" }}` [1m]))

panels.title: Total Flows
panels.description: Count of flow lines the observer wrote to Loki in the time range, after the dashboard's filters. With verdictFilter=DROPPED (default) this is the number of dropped flows.

options.content:
<!-- caption -->
**Flows** in the range from or to the namespaces `mongodb` and `search`, forwarded and dropped (this lab's observer: `--namespace mongodb --namespace search --type trace:to-endpoint --type drop`), each counted once: at its destination, or where it was dropped.

targets.expr:
sum by(flow_verdict) (
    count_over_time(
        {namespace="$hubbleobservernamespace",container="$container"} |~ `(?i)$searchregex` !~ `(?i)$excluderegex`
        | $logparser | flow_source_namespace=~"$sourcenamespace" | flow_destination_namespace=~"$destinationnamespace" | flow_traffic_direction=~"$direction" | flow_IP_ipVersion=~"$ipversion"
        | flow_source_cluster_name=~"$sourcecluster" | flow_destination_cluster_name=~"$destinationcluster"
    [$__range])
)

panels.title: Flows per Verdict
panels.description: Hubble verdict of each flow (flow.verdict): FORWARDED, DROPPED, AUDIT (would have been dropped, policy audit mode), REDIRECTED (to the L7 proxy), ERROR, TRACED. The observer's verdictFilter decides which verdicts reach Loki at all.

options.content:
<!-- caption -->
Forwarded flows and drops are streamed here. FORWARDED is the normal case; a DROPPED slice is a refused connection between the namespaces or the clusters.

targets.expr:
sum by(flow_traffic_direction) (
    count_over_time(
        {namespace="$hubbleobservernamespace",container="$container"} |~ `(?i)$searchregex` !~ `(?i)$excluderegex`
        | $logparser | flow_source_namespace=~"$sourcenamespace" | flow_destination_namespace=~"$destinationnamespace" | flow_traffic_direction=~"$direction" | flow_IP_ipVersion=~"$ipversion"
        | flow_source_cluster_name=~"$sourcecluster" | flow_destination_cluster_name=~"$destinationcluster"
    [$__range])
)

panels.title: Flows per Direction
panels.description: flow.traffic_direction as Cilium saw the packet at the enforcement point: EGRESS = at the source endpoint, INGRESS = at the destination endpoint. For a drop it says whose policy decided.

options.content:
<!-- caption -->
The direction Cilium gives each flow. For drops: **EGRESS** = the source's egress policy decided, **INGRESS** = the destination's ingress policy.

targets.expr:
topk(10, sum by(flow_source_namespace) (
    count_over_time(
        {namespace="$hubbleobservernamespace",container="$container"} |~ `(?i)$searchregex` !~ `(?i)$excluderegex`
        | $logparser | flow_verdict="DROPPED" | flow_source_namespace!="" | flow_source_namespace=~"$sourcenamespace" | flow_destination_namespace=~"$destinationnamespace" | flow_traffic_direction=~"$direction" | flow_IP_ipVersion=~"$ipversion"
        | flow_source_cluster_name=~"$sourcecluster" | flow_destination_cluster_name=~"$destinationcluster"
    [$__range])
))

panels.title: Top dropped sources — by namespace
panels.description: topk(10) of dropped flows by flow.source.namespace. Sources without a namespace (host, world, remote-node, kube-apiserver identities) are filtered out by flow_source_namespace!="".

options.content:
<!-- caption -->

Who is being denied, ranked by dropped flows (top 10). Flows without a source namespace (host, world, remote-node identities) are excluded.

targets.expr:
topk(10, sum by(flow_destination_name) (
    count_over_time(
        {namespace="$hubbleobservernamespace",container="$container"} |~ `(?i)$searchregex` !~ `(?i)$excluderegex`
        | $logparser | flow_verdict="DROPPED" | flow_source_namespace=~"$sourcenamespace" | flow_destination_namespace=~"$destinationnamespace" | flow_traffic_direction=~"$direction" | flow_IP_ipVersion=~"$ipversion" 
        | flow_source_cluster_name=~"$sourcecluster" | flow_destination_cluster_name=~"$destinationcluster"
        | json flow_destination_name="flow.destination_names[0]" | flow_destination_name!="" 
    [$__range])
))

panels.title: Top dropped destinations — by DNS name
panels.description: topk(10) of dropped flows by flow.destination_names[0] — the DNS name Cilium's DNS proxy recorded for the destination IP. A name is present only when the source is under an L7 DNS policy (rules.dns) so the proxy saw the lookup.

options.content:
<!-- caption -->

Only flows whose destination IP was resolved through Cilium's DNS proxy carry a name (`destination_names`, an L7 DNS rule on the source). Empty = no DNS-visibility policy on the dropped sources.

targets.expr:
sum by(drop_reason) (
    count_over_time(
        {namespace="$hubbleobservernamespace",container="$container"} |~ `(?i)$searchregex` !~ `(?i)$excluderegex`
        | $logparser | flow_verdict="DROPPED" | flow_source_namespace=~"$sourcenamespace" | flow_destination_namespace=~"$destinationnamespace" | flow_traffic_direction=~"$direction" | flow_IP_ipVersion=~"$ipversion" | flow_source_cluster_name=~"$sourcecluster" | flow_destination_cluster_name=~"$destinationcluster"
        | label_format drop_reason="{{ if .flow_drop_reason_desc }}{{ .flow_drop_reason_desc }}{{ else if .flow_l7_type }}L7 denied by the proxy ({{ .flow_l7_type }}){{ else }}DROP_REASON_UNKNOWN{{ end }}"
    [$__range])
)

panels.title: Flows per Drop Reason
panels.description: Cilium's drop reason of each DROPPED flow (flow.drop_reason_desc): POLICY_DENIED = no rule allowed it, POLICY_DENY = an explicit deny rule, SERVICE_BACKEND_NOT_FOUND, … Only flows whose verdict is DROPPED count (the stream carries every verdict when verdictFilter is none). A flow denied by the L7 proxy carries no drop_reason_desc in its JSON (the enum's zero value, DROP_REASON_UNKNOWN, is omitted), so it is named here from its L7 record instead of appearing as an empty label.

options.content:
<!-- caption -->

**POLICY_DENIED** = no rule allowed it (default deny). **POLICY_DENY** = an explicit deny rule. **STALE_OR_UNROUTABLE_IP** = the destination IP is gone (a pod that no longer exists). Others: datapath, not policy.

targets.expr:
sum by(denied_by) (
    count_over_time(
        {namespace="$hubbleobservernamespace",container="$container"} |~ `(?i)$searchregex` !~ `(?i)$excluderegex`
        | $logparser | flow_verdict="DROPPED" | flow_drop_reason_desc=~"^POLICY_DEN(Y|IED)$" | flow_source_namespace=~"$sourcenamespace" | flow_destination_namespace=~"$destinationnamespace" | flow_traffic_direction=~"$direction" | flow_IP_ipVersion=~"$ipversion" | flow_source_cluster_name=~"$sourcecluster" | flow_destination_cluster_name=~"$destinationcluster" | json egress_denied="flow.egress_denied_by[0].name", ingress_denied="flow.ingress_denied_by[0].name"
        | label_format denied_by=`{{ if .egress_denied }}{{ .egress_denied }}{{ else if .ingress_denied }}{{ .ingress_denied }}{{ else if eq .flow_drop_reason_desc "POLICY_DENY" }}explicit deny (policy name unavailable){{ else }}default deny (no matching allow){{ end }}`
    [$__range])
)

panels.title: Policy drops by denying policy
panels.description: Only DROPPED flows whose reason is POLICY_DENIED or POLICY_DENY, by the policy Cilium's correlation names (flow.egress_denied_by[0].name or flow.ingress_denied_by[0].name — Loki's json parser skips arrays, so the element is read by JSON path). A POLICY_DENY with no name is an explicit deny whose name correlation did not supply; a POLICY_DENIED with no name is the default deny — no rule allowed the flow.

options.content:
<!-- caption -->

Names the deny rule from `egress_denied_by` / `ingress_denied_by`; a default-deny drop names none (gotcha #82), so it counts as "default deny (no matching allow)".

panels.description: One bar per interval ($__auto, at least 30s): how many flows the observer received in it, split by verdict — DROPPED only with the chart's default verdictFilter, every verdict when it is none. The same filters as the panels above (namespaces, direction, IP version, clusters, the regexes). A burst of red is a burst of drops; the History table below lists them.

targets.expr:
sum by(flow_verdict) (
    count_over_time(
        {namespace="$hubbleobservernamespace",container="$container"} |~ `(?i)$searchregex` !~ `(?i)$excluderegex`
        | $logparser | flow_source_namespace=~"$sourcenamespace" | flow_destination_namespace=~"$destinationnamespace" | flow_traffic_direction=~"$direction" | flow_IP_ipVersion=~"$ipversion"
        | flow_source_cluster_name=~"$sourcecluster" | flow_destination_cluster_name=~"$destinationcluster"
    [$__auto])
)

panels.title: Flows over time, by verdict

options.content:
<!-- caption -->
Flows per 30 s, by verdict. Replication, mongot's sync and searches keep FORWARDED steady; a DROPPED line is a refused connection.
